speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
text: asked the Minister for Transport whether incidences of molestation on MRT premises are treated as high priority for staff intervention when they are reported and what happened with the 12 September 2018 incident at Serangoon MRT station.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: We take a serious view towards all security incidents.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) and TransCom will continue to work closely with the Public Transport Operators to ensure the safety of our commuters.

speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: What is the protocol in such instances where the staff is alerted to the incident of alleged molestation?

speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Does it involve giving chase or stopping the molester from escaping from the scene of crime?

speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: And are staff trained to handle the sensitivity of the victims who, understandably, would be emotionally distressed?

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: There is the issue, of course, as to whether the perpetrator could become violent.
